testCases.title: Login with empty email and empty password
testCases.steps:
1. Open the Login Page at https://www.facebook.com/
2. Leave the Email or phone field empty
3. Leave the Password field empty
4. Click the Log in button
5. Confirm the message 'Please enter your email or phone number' is visible
testCases.expectedResult:
1. Login page is shown
2. Email or phone is empty
3. Password is empty
4. Submit is clicked
5. Error message 'Please enter your email or phone number' is shown

2. Enter in the Email or phone field
3. Enter in the Password field
4. Double-click the Log in button rapidly
5. Confirm the message 'Incorrect email or phone number' is visible and the page remains stable
testCases.expectedResult:

2. Email or phone is accepted
3. Password is accepted
4. Double submit is handled without crash
5. Error message 'Incorrect email or phone number' is shown

testCases.title: Login while network is unavailable
testCases.steps:
1. Disable network connectivity on the test device
2. Open the Login Page at https://www.facebook.com/
3. Enter in the Email or phone field
4. Enter in the Password field
5. Click the Log in button
6. Confirm a network-unavailable or connection error message is visible
testCases.expectedResult:
1. Network is offline
2. Login page load fails or shows offline state
3. Email or phone is entered
4. Password is entered
5. Submit is clicked
6. Error message indicating network unavailability is shown

coverageNotes: Covers all four negative scenario groups from the user story: missing credentials (TC_01–TC_03), invalid credentials (TC_04–TC_05), malformed/extreme input (TC_06–TC_08), and abnormal conditions (TC_09 double-submit EXECUTE, TC_10 network-unavailable MANUAL).
